import pandas as pd

SOURCE_URI = '/tmp/events.csv'   # <-- confirm/correct me here

# Read once to inspect, then describe a streaming contract (chunked reads)
sample = pd.read_csv(SOURCE_URI, nrows=1000)
print(sample.dtypes)
print(sample.head())

# Continuous binding = chunked/iterative reader
def stream(uri, chunk_size=10_000):
    for chunk in pd.read_csv(uri, chunksize=chunk_size):
        yield chunk
